summary: Nerdy Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing stockholder approval at a special meeting on August 13, 2026, of a reverse stock split authorization. The board subsequently approved a 1-for-15 reverse split of Class A and Class B common stock, filing a Delaware certificate of amendment effective August 19, 2026. Every 15 shares reclassify into one share, with proportionate adjustments to equity awards and outstanding units; no rights changes. The split aims to maintain NYSE listing compliance, though no delisting threat was stated. Watch for trading adjustments and potential future compliance actions.
